an7.7:1.1: Atha kho Uggo rājamahāmatto yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Uggo rājamahāmatto Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an7.7:2.2: yāva aḍḍho 'vāyaṃ bhante Migāro Rohaṇeyyo yāva mahaddhano yāva mahābhogo' ti.
an7.7:2.3: ‘Kīva aḍḍho pan' Ugga Migāro Rohaṇeyyo kīva mahaddhano kīva mahābhogo' ti?
an7.7:2.4: ‘Sataṃ bhante satasahassānaṃ hiraññassa, ko pana vādo rūpiyassā' ti.
an7.7:2.5: ‘Atthi kho etaṃ Ugga dhanaṃ? N' etaṃ natthī ti vadāmi,
an7.7:2.6: tañ ca kho etaṃ Ugga dhanaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ agginā udakena rājūhi corehi appiyehi dāyādehi.
an7.7:2.7: Satta kho imāni Ugga dhanāni asādhāraṇāni agginā udakena rājūhi corehi appiyehi dāyādehi.
an7.7:2.9: Saddhādhanaṃ, sīladhanaṃ, hiridhanaṃ, ottappadhanaṃ, sutadhanaṃ, cāgadhanaṃ, paññādhanaṃ.
an7.7:2.10: Imāni kho Ugga satta dhanāni asādhāraṇāni agginā udakena rājūhi corehi appiyehi dāyādehī' ti.
